channel.title: FridgePaper: Family Budget Printables
channel.description: Free printables from FridgePaper for the Family Budget Printables board.

item.title: Free Printable Monthly Budget Planner (Simple, One Page)
item.description: A simple one-page monthly budget worksheet for families. List your income, plan each expense, then track what you actually spent. Free to print or save as a PDF.

item.title: Grocery Budget Calculator: Per Week, Per Person, Per Meal
item.description: How much should groceries cost per meal? Enter your monthly grocery budget and family size, and this free calculator shows your weekly budget, daily cost per person, and cost per meal.

item.title: 12 Easy Ways to Lower Your Family Grocery Bill
item.description: Spend less on groceries without clipping coupons all day. 12 practical tips for families, plus a free grocery budget calculator and a printable grocery list.

item.title: How Much Allowance Should a Kid Get? Guide by Age
item.description: How much allowance by age, how to split it into save, spend and give, and whether to tie it to chores. Simple guide plus a free allowance calculator.

item.title: Simple Family Budget Worksheet (Free One-Page Monthly Printable)
item.description: Budgeting doesn't need an app. Write down what comes in, plan where it goes, then fill in what you really spent, all on one page. A simple monthly budget worksheet for families. Free to print or save as a PDF.

item.title: How to Save Money on Groceries for a Family (No Coupons)
item.description: Cut your family grocery bill without clipping coupons: plan around what you have, try store brands, compare unit prices, and use your freezer. 12 practical tips plus a free grocery budget calculator.

item.title: Allowance Chart by Age: How Much Should Kids Get Each Week?
item.description: A simple starting point: $1 per year of age, per week. How to decide what allowance covers, how to split it into save, spend and give, and whether to tie it to chores. Free allowance calculator included.

item.title: Family Grocery Budget Calculator: Cost Per Meal and Per Person
item.description: Is your grocery budget realistic? Enter your monthly budget, family size and meals at home to see your weekly budget, daily cost per person, and cost per meal. Free, no sign-up.
